name: king_cobra_swallowing_viper
description: King cobra (Ophiophagus hannah): heavy olive #6b7a3a body, darker olive back #4f5a2a, thin pale cream chevron bands #e8e0a8 pointing toward the head and fading toward it, pale yellow throat #e8d890, large smooth head shields, small dark eye under a heavy brow, NARROW hood (barely wider than the neck; never the wide Naja disc). Lying on the ground, head at the right (about (+120,-88)), jaws stretched round the rear end of a prey snake (green pit viper: short, ~200 long, pale belly line) that leaves its mouth and lies on the ground to the right, ending in a tail tip. Slight lump in the cobra's neck. No blood. Anchor bottom-centre; bbox x -560..+560, y -129..0 (one drawing, 5 prey palettes).
